plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a clear one: up to three quick questions, a rewrite, and a side-by-side review before anything runs.

plugins.name: work-report
plugins.description: Counts the tasks Claude finishes for you and estimates the hours saved and what that time is worth, by day, week, month and year.

plugins.name: skill-router
plugins.description: Runs each skill on the right size of model: simple fixed-step skills on Haiku, the rest picked by Jev through OpenRouter, never above the session model. Logs every pick with its time and cost.
